A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same WHISPER study and contain 19 readable pages, including Appendices A–B. The text, equations, seven tables and fourteen figures support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original benchmark experiments, prompt-effectiveness analyses, commercial API evaluations and a manual safety assessment of 300 generated outputs.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results in Sections 5–6 and Appendix B, including benchmark scores, supplementary analyses and safety-assessment outcomes.

M1.justification: Sections 3–4 and Appendix A retain the same prompt generation, accuracy filtering, response-length ranking and iterative refinement procedure. Prompt templates and selected candidates are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use PRM800K for prompt development and evaluate GSM8K, MATH-500, AMC 2023, AIME 2024, GPQA-Diamond and CommonsenseQA. No datasets, tasks, domains or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains NoThinking, BeConcise, ChainofDraft, GEPA and DEER. The extended model comparisons in Tables 6–7 continue to omit GEPA in both versions.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 and Appendices B.1–B.2 retain the 100-instance PDSet, model configurations, evaluation metrics, decoding settings and baseline procedures. The 300-output safety-assessment design in Appendix B.6 is also unchanged.

E4.justification: The perspective comparisons, generalizability and sensitivity analyses, refinement study, PDSet correlation analysis and safety assessments remain unchanged. Appendix B also retains the same illustrative cases in Figures 10–14.

E5.justification: Appendix B.1 retains three samples per question for GSM8K and MATH-500 and eight for AMC 2023 and AIME 2024. Statistical displays and reporting practices are unchanged; no seed information, confidence intervals or significance tests are added.

E6.justification: Numerical results, rankings and qualitative findings match throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 1 retains 89.6% accuracy and a 63.0% compression ratio for Qwen3-14B with WHISPER; Figure 3 retains the same API results.

T1.justification: The task objective, i.i.d. assumption for PDSet and average-length and accuracy equations (1)–(2) are unchanged. No mathematical definitions, proofs or derivations are added or revised.

C1.justification: The claims of black-box reasoning efficiency without additional training, preserved performance and broad generalizability remain unchanged. Replacing 'across all benchmarks' with 'overall' in the abstract does not substantively change the claim's scope.

C2.justification: Interpretations of perspective effectiveness, model sensitivity and transfer remain unchanged, as do limitations concerning model coverage and persuasive perspectives. Section 4.1 simplifies wording about evidence influencing behavior without changing the mechanism argument.

D1.justification: The generator and API versions, prompt templates, hyperparameters, software and hardware specifications, baseline implementation instructions and code-access statements remain unchanged in the main text and appendices.

R1.justification: The cited works and bibliography are unchanged after accounting for reflow. Related-work comparisons and the claimed novelty of applying persuasive prompting to reasoning efficiency are retained.

P1.justification: v3 shortens wording in the abstract and Section 4.1, corrects 'an 1.4×' to 'a 1.4×' and 'Rolelay-III' to 'RolePlay-III', and adds reviewer and funding acknowledgements. The research sections retain their structure and order.

P2.justification: v3 removes printed page-number footers and makes small changes to text flow and figure/table positioning. The acknowledgements shift the bibliography's layout. Figures, table structures, captions and visual encodings remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 supplies routine copyediting, a prompt-label correction and acknowledgements while retaining the same scientific content, empirical evidence and reproducibility information throughout the main text and appendices. These edits provide small editorial polish without meaningfully changing the paper's overall clarity, rigor or evidential support.
